title: Hanuma conveys Seetha's message to Sri Rama
introduction: Angada, Hanuma and other monkeys approach Rama, Lakshmana and Sugreeva at Mount Prasravana. When monkeys start narrating the news of Seetha, Rama asks further details of Seetha. Then, the monkeys request Hanuma to explain the occurrences to Rama in detail. Then, Hanuma appraises Rama of Seetha's presence at the foot of a Simsupa tree in the midst of female-demons. After narrating the incidents related by her and delivering to Rama the jewel for the head, earlier handed-over by Seetha as a token, Hanuma conveys her message to Rama.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 65th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रस्रवणम् शैलम् ते गत्वा चित्र काननम् |
प्रणम्य शिरसा रामम् लक्ष्मणम् च महाबलम्
युव राजम् पुरः कृत्य सुग्रीवम् अभिवाद्य च |
प्रवृत्तम् अथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुम् उपचक्रमुः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prasravaṇam śailam te gatvā citra kānanam |
praṇamya śirasā rāmam lakṣmaṇam ca mahābalam
yuva rājam puraḥ kṛtya sugrīvam abhivādya ca |
pravṛttam atha sītāyāḥ pravaktum upacakramuḥ
verses.translation: Keeping Angada the prince in their forefront those monkeys, on reaching Mount Prasravana having forests of variegated appearance, offered their salutation by bowing their heads in reverence to Rama and the mighty Lakshmana, greeting Sugreeva respectfully. Then, they started narrating the news of Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
रावण अन्तः पुरे रोधम् राक्षसीभिः च तर्जनम् |
रामे समनुरागम् च यः च अपि समयः कृतः
एतत् आख्यान्ति ते सर्वे हरयो राम सम्निधौ |
verses.iast:
rāvaṇa antaḥ pure rodham rākṣasībhiḥ ca tarjanam |
rāme samanurāgam ca yaḥ ca api samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
etat ākhyānti te sarve harayo rāma samnidhau |
verses.translation: Those monkeys started to narrate, in the presence of Rama, about, the female-demons, and frightening Seetha in Ravana's gynaecium, her complete affection towards Rama and the time-limit of two months given by Ravana.

glosses.meaning: and the time-limit (two months) given by Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
वैदेहीम् अक्षताम् श्रुत्वा रामः तु उत्तरम् अब्रवीत्
क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथम् च मयि वर्तते |
एतन् मे सर्वम् आख्यात वैदेहीम् प्रति वानराः
verses.iast:
vaidehīm akṣatām śrutvā rāmaḥ tu uttaram abravīt
kva sītā vartate devī katham ca mayi vartate |
etan me sarvam ākhyāta vaidehīm prati vānarāḥ
verses.translation: Hearing of Seetha being alive, Rama on his part replied, "Where is Seetha, the princess? How is she disposed towards me? O monkeys! Tell me all that about Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य गदितम् श्रुत्व हरयो राम सम्निधौ |
चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तम् सीता वृत्त अन्त कोविदम्
verses.iast:
rāmasya gaditam śrutva harayo rāma samnidhau |
codayanti hanūmantam sītā vṛtta anta kovidam
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, the monkeys urged Hanuma to tell, in the presence of Rama, all the incidents because he knew them better, about Seetha.

glosses.meaning: (since) Hanuma knows all the incidents about Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनम् तेषाम् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः |
प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै ताम् दिशम् प्रति
उवाच वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनम् यथा |
verses.iast:
śrutvā tu vacanam teṣām hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā devyai sītāyai tām diśam prati
uvāca vākyam vākyajñaḥ sītāyā darśanam yathā |
verses.translation: Hearing the words of those monkeys, the eloquent Hanuma, the son of wind-god saluting towards the direction of the Seetha the princess by bowing his head, spoke the following words, explaining how he saw Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
समुद्रम् लन्घयित्वा अहम् शत योजनम् आयतम्
अगच्छम् जानकीम् सीताम् मार्गमाणो दिदृक्षया |
verses.iast:
samudram langhayitvā aham śata yojanam āyatam
agaccham jānakīm sītām mārgamāṇo didṛkṣayā |
verses.translation: "Having gone across the ocean, a hundred Yojanas wide, I reached the southern shore looking in search of Seetha, Janaka's daughter, with a wish to see her."

glosses.meaning: with a wish to see Seetha
of a width of one hundred Yojanas

verses.devanagari:
तत्र लन्का इति नगरी रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य तीरे वसति दक्षिणे |
verses.iast:
tatra lankā iti nagarī rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
dakṣiṇasya samudrasya tīre vasati dakṣiṇe |
verses.translation: "There at the southern shore of the southern ocean, there is city called Lanka of the evil-minded Ravana."

verses.devanagari:
तत्र दृष्टा मया सीता रावण अन्तः पुरे सती
सम्न्यस्य त्वयि जीवन्ती रामा राम मनो रथम् |
verses.iast:
tatra dṛṣṭā mayā sītā rāvaṇa antaḥ pure satī
samnyasya tvayi jīvantī rāmā rāma mano ratham |
verses.translation: "O Rama! There, living in Ravana's gynaecium in the city, I saw the lady Seetha, your virtuous wife, centering here heart's desire in you."

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टा मे राक्षसी मध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुः मुहुः
राक्षसीभिः विरूपाभी रक्षिता प्रमदा वने |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭā me rākṣasī madhye tarjyamānā muhuḥ muhuḥ
rākṣasībhiḥ virūpābhī rakṣitā pramadā vane |
verses.translation: "In that pleasure garden, I saw Seetha sitting in the midst of female demons, guarded by those ugly-faced female-demons as also time and again being threatened by them."

glosses.meaning: in the midst of female demons

verses.devanagari:
दुह्खम् आपद्यते देवी तव अदुह्ख उचिता सती
रावण अन्तः पुरे रुद्ध्वा राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता |
एक वेणी धरा दीना त्वयि चिन्ता परायणा
अधः शय्या विवर्ण अन्गी पद्मिनी इव हिम आगमे |
रावणात् विनिवृत्त अर्था मर्तव्य कृत निश्चया
देवी कथंचित् काकुत्स्थ त्वन् मना मार्गिता मया |
verses.iast:
duhkham āpadyate devī tava aduhkha ucitā satī
rāvaṇa antaḥ pure ruddhvā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā |
eka veṇī dharā dīnā tvayi cintā parāyaṇā
adhaḥ śayyā vivarṇa angī padminī iva hima āgame |
rāvaṇāt vinivṛtta arthā martavya kṛta niścayā
devī kathaṃcit kākutstha tvan manā mārgitā mayā |
verses.translation: "O hero! Seetha, who deserves to live happily with you, is obtaining grief. O Rama! I somehow searched that princess, Seetha wearing a single plait (as a as a mark of desolation), looking miserable, remaining absorbed in your thought, reposing on the floor, having discoloured limbs like a lotus in winter, turning back the wish from Ravana, having determined to die, but thinking of you alone."

glosses.meaning: wearing a single plait (as a mark of desolation)

verses.devanagari:
इक्ष्वाकु वंश विख्यातिम् शनैः कीर्तयत अनघ
स मया नर शार्दूल विश्वासम् उपपादिता |
verses.iast:
ikṣvāku vaṃśa vikhyātim śanaiḥ kīrtayata anagha
sa mayā nara śārdūla viśvāsam upapāditā |
verses.translation: "O faultless tiger among men! Seetha established confidence in me, after I slowly described to her the fame of Ikshvaku dynasty."

verses.devanagari:
ततः सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वम् अर्थम् च दर्शिता
राम सुग्रीव सख्यम् च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिम् उपागता |
नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिः च अस्याः तथा त्वयि
verses.iast:
tataḥ sambhāṣitā devī sarvam artham ca darśitā
rāma sugrīva sakhyam ca śrutvā prītim upāgatā |
niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktiḥ ca asyāḥ tathā tvayi
verses.translation: "Thereafter, I spoke and explained to Seetha, about the entire significance of my arrival there. On hearing about the alliance between Rama and Sugreeva, she was quite pleased. Her morality as well as her devotion in you are steadfast."

glosses.meaning: about all the significance (of my arrival)
about the friendship between Rama and Sugreeva

verses.devanagari:
एवम् मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनक नन्दिनी |
उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वत् भक्त्या पुरुष ऋषभ
verses.iast:
evam mayā mahābhāgā dṛṣṭā janaka nandinī |
ugreṇa tapasā yuktā tvat bhaktyā puruṣa ṛṣabha
verses.translation: "O, the foremost of men! I thus saw that illustrious Seetha, endowed with severe penance and devotion towards you."

verses.devanagari:
अभिज्ञानम् च मे दत्तम् यथा वृत्तम् तव अन्तिके |
चित्र कूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसम् प्रति राघव
verses.iast:
abhijñānam ca me dattam yathā vṛttam tava antike |
citra kūṭe mahāprājña vāyasam prati rāghava
verses.translation: "O Rama, of great intelligence! To me, she gave as a token of remembrance, a previous event of a crow occurred at your vicinity in Mount Chitrakuta."

verses.devanagari:
विज्ञाप्यः च नर व्याघ्रो रामो वायु सुत त्वया |
अखिलेन इह यत् दृष्टम् इति माम् आह जानकी
verses.iast:
vijñāpyaḥ ca nara vyāghro rāmo vāyu suta tvayā |
akhilena iha yat dṛṣṭam iti mām āha jānakī
verses.translation: "Seetha spoke to me saying, 'O Hanuma! Inform Rama, the foremost among men, all that you have seen here."

verses.devanagari:
अयम् च अस्मै प्रदातव्यम् यत्नात् सुपरिरक्षितम् |
ब्रुवता वचनानि एवम् सुग्रीवस्य उपशृण्वतः
verses.iast:
ayam ca asmai pradātavyam yatnāt suparirakṣitam |
bruvatā vacanāni evam sugrīvasya upaśṛṇvataḥ
verses.translation: "While Sugreeva is hearing nearby and while you are telling the words in this way, let this jewel, which is deliberately well-guarded, be given to Rama."

verses.devanagari:
एष चूडा मणिः श्रीमान् मया ते यत्न रक्षितः |
मनः शिलायाः तिकलः तम् स्मरस्व इति च अब्रवीत्
त्वया प्राष्टे तिम्के तम् किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
eṣa cūḍā maṇiḥ śrīmān mayā te yatna rakṣitaḥ |
manaḥ śilāyāḥ tikalaḥ tam smarasva iti ca abravīt
tvayā prāṣṭe timke tam kila smartumarhasi |
verses.translation: "This beautiful jewel for the head has been well-guarded by me. You also ought to recall a mark indeed painted by you (by slip) on the curve of my cheek with powder of an orange-red rock, when my former mark on my forehead got effaced."

glosses.meaning: on the curve of my cheek
when my former mark on my forehead

verses.devanagari:
एष निर्यातितः श्रीमान् मया ते वारि सम्भवः
एतम् दृष्ट्वा प्रमोदिष्ये व्यसने त्वाम् इव अनघ |
verses.iast:
eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vāri sambhavaḥ
etam dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvām iva anagha |
verses.translation: "This beautiful jewel, which has its origin in sea-water, has been sent to you. Seeing this in my grief, I am feeling always happy as though I am seeing you."

glosses.meaning: which has its origin in sea-water
as though I am seeing you.

verses.devanagari:
जीवितम् धारयिष्यामि मासम् दशरथ आत्मज
ऊर्ध्वम् मासान् न जीवेयम् रक्षसाम् वशम् आगता |
verses.iast:
jīvitam dhārayiṣyāmi māsam daśaratha ātmaja
ūrdhvam māsān na jīveyam rakṣasām vaśam āgatā |
verses.translation: "O Rama! I shall be sustaining my life for a month. Having come into the control of demons, I cannot survive beyond one month."

verses.devanagari:
इति माम् अब्रवीत् सीता कृश अन्गी धर्म चारिणी
रावण अन्तः पुरे रुद्धा मृगी इव उत्फुल्ल लोचना |
verses.iast:
iti mām abravīt sītā kṛśa angī dharma cāriṇī
rāvaṇa antaḥ pure ruddhā mṛgī iva utphulla locanā |
verses.translation: "Seetha, with her emaciated body, practicing virtue, confined in Ravana's gynaecium and with her wide-open eyes like that of a doe, spoke to me the following words:

verses.devanagari:
एतत् एव मया आख्यातम् सर्वम् राघव यत् यथा
सर्वथा सागर जले सम्तारः प्रविधीयताम् |
verses.iast:
etat eva mayā ākhyātam sarvam rāghava yat yathā
sarvathā sāgara jale samtāraḥ pravidhīyatām |
verses.translation: "O Rama! I have narrated to you whatever has occurred, in its entirety. Let a bridge be constructed, by all means, across the waters of the ocean."

glosses.meaning: in the waters of the ocean.

verses.devanagari:
तौ जात आश्वासौ राज पुत्रौ विदित्वा |
तच् च अभिज्ञानम् राघवाय प्रदाय |
देव्या च आख्यातम् सर्वम् एव आनुपूर्व्यात् |
वाचा सम्पूर्णम् वायु पुत्रः शशंस
verses.iast:
tau jāta āśvāsau rāja putrau viditvā |
tac ca abhijñānam rāghavāya pradāya |
devyā ca ākhyātam sarvam eva ānupūrvyāt |
vācā sampūrṇam vāyu putraḥ śaśaṃsa
verses.translation: Coming to know that the two princes, Rama and Lakshmana have become confident and having given that token of remembrance to Rama, Hanuma apprised completely in so many words, in regular succession, all that was conveyed by Seetha, the princess.
